ModMetaData.name: Better Kibble
ModMetaData.author: Coldcrow
ModMetaData.description:
Better Kibble aims to be an all-in-one improvement to vanilla kibble and aspects relating to its usage, storage, and crafting. This mod is designed to enhance the gameplay experience for RimWorld players who utilize kibble as a primary source of nutrition for their animals.
Main Features of "Better Kibble" include: - Adds vegetarian kibble recipes in 10x and 100x quantities, including crafting kibble with only hay. - Adds kibble dispenser (and associated neolithic era research). - Substantially re-balances kibble by reducing value, slightly increasing cost to make, and significantly increasing nutritional value. - No decay for kibble, feed your outdoor animals without needing to build a barn.
